_about: Years whose maps were reviewed against scientific sources. 'years': maps drawn only from dated finds — empty land is hatched as 'No data'. 'probability': maps where an area is coloured if the species' presence is more likely than 50 % — no hatching, empty land = 'probability below 50 %'. 'coastNotes': key of a note shown under the year (translations/ui); on a map with an ancient coastline it is shown after the sea level. 'regions': for a map reviewed only in part, the outline (corrections/regions/<shape>.geojson) of the reviewed parts — only there empty land is hatched — and the key of a note under the year. See corrections/README.md.
